Jordan —

Appreciate the packet. Quick note from Tax: the TIN on the IRS confirmation does not match the TIN entered on the W-9 form we received (looks like a digit transposition). We need a brief follow-up so finance can validate with Treasury e-file and push PO creation. Please provide the following so we can clear the PO gate: 

1) A corrected W-9 with handwritten or e-signature matching the authorized signer (PDF).
2) A copy of the EIN assignment letter (SS-4) or the IRS confirmation letter showing the exact EIN text.
3) A signatory authority letter on company letterhead if the person signing the W-9 is not listed on the SS-4 (signed and dated).

Note: Without item #1–#3 we cannot setup the vendor for ACH or issue a PO. If you can provide the corrected docs by end of week we can move forward.

Thanks — copying Monica from AP to coordinate bank details once tax clears.

Best,
Marissa Cole
